scripts.codegen: turbo run codegen:all && turbo run codegen --filter=!gtkx
scripts.codegen:all: NODE_OPTIONS=--conditions=source pnpm exec tsx packages/cli/src/cli.ts codegen
scripts.coverage: turbo run coverage:all && turbo run coverage --filter=!gtkx
scripts.lint: turbo run lint:all && turbo run lint --filter=!gtkx
scripts.release: turbo run build --filter=!gtkx --filter='!./examples/*' --filter=!./website --filter=!@gtkx/e2e && turbo run release --filter=!gtkx --filter='!./examples/*' --filter=!./website --filter=!@gtkx/e2e
scripts.test: turbo run test:all && turbo run test --filter=!gtkx
scripts.typecheck: turbo run typecheck:all && turbo run typecheck --filter=!gtkx
